site_structure_reference.products_index: https://partner.vertilux.com/en/products (61 paginated pages, ~23 products per page; each product page at /en/products/<slug> lists colourway codes + names, swatch image URLs at http://vertilux-website.s3.amazonaws.com/public/original/<code>.jpg, composition, roll width/length, weight, thickness, FR rating, certificates and application mapping)

notes: Application-page marketing descriptions are truncated by the site itself (teaser text ending in '...'); the full paragraphs load via JavaScript 'read more' and were not retrievable with plain HTTP fetches.

Collection detail pages (/en/collections/<slug>, e.g. high-living-collection, rollux-collection, polyscreenvision-collection, solar-screen, gleamorous-collection, dunes-aurora, neolux-collections) consistently returned empty responses to the fetcher (likely server-side error or JS-only rendering for anonymous/non-JS clients). Collection names, URLs and verbatim descriptions were instead captured from the /en/collections index page, which renders fully.

The fabric carousels on application pages (the per-application fabric line links) are JavaScript-rendered and did not appear in fetched HTML, so the application-to-fabric-line mapping was reconstructed from collection names/descriptions and the two working product detail pages.

Individual fabric detail pages at /en/products/<slug> ARE publicly accessible and rich (colour codes + names, swatch URLs, composition, width, FR rating, certificates). Two were captured in full: Stucco (roller decorative) and Dunes Aurora. 'Pinpointe Blackout FR' could not be located (slugs /en/products/pinpointe-blackout-fr and /en/products/pinpointe both returned empty).

The full products index spans 61 pages (~1,400 items including motors/components); only page 1 was captured within the fetch budget. The ?application= and ?application_id= URL filters do not filter server-side (the filter form is JS-driven).
Site notes that logged-in accounts 'unlock more complete information about our products' - pricing and some data are login-gated; everything captured here is from public pages.
sitemap.xml does not exist; /en/search and /en/product_type/fabrics also returned empty responses.
Approximately 22 successful page fetches were used (plus ~15 empty/failed attempts), within the ~40-fetch budget.

Vertical Blinds, Roman Shades, Drapes and Exterior Solutions applications exist on the site but were out of scope per the brief; several products in the index sample (e.g. Itaca, Bimini Vertical, South Beach) belong to Vertical Blinds.
